text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking along the street
back to
my place...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: GYAAAHHHH!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: Dang it... Messed up again...
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, when'd you get here, minion?!
Your timin's
perfect! Help me with my
gate trainin'!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
I assume that scream just now was the
sound of
her struggling with training, so I
decide to help
her out. However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When I get into the gate, you give me
the signal
to start. Got it?!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: All riiiiight... I'm in!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Gimme the signal! The signal, dang it!
Come on,
c'mon, c'mon!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: GWEH?!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Surprised by her yelp, I rush over to
find... Shinko
Windy's foot stuck in a
deep hole at the starting
line. She's
sprawled dramatically across the
ground.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Grrrr... DANG IT! Why do I keep fallin'?!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
And after all that fidgetin' I did to build
up
power! GAH!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди
choice_data_list: I think the fidgeting might be the problem...

text_block_list.text:
That's not true! The fidgetin' is proof I'm
gettin'
fired up to run like the wind! Plus
it helps with
gettin' off to a good start!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
That puts all eyes on me! And that's
when I chomp
down hard on first place!
That's the perfect race,
right?!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
While it's true that a competitive spirit is
vital for
racing, her fidgeting feet are
what dug the hole
that tripped her up
and bungled her all-important
start.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...I need to persuade her to look at it in
a
different light.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I think you could do better.

text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! Whatcha tryin' to say?!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди
choice_data_list:
If you save all that fire for after the gates open,
people are gonna go wild.

text_block_list.text:
I explain that people get caught off
guard by
unpredictable surprises, and
that she'd look
cooler if she kept her
competitiveness under
wraps until the
race was underway.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Competitive spirit... lookin' cool...
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Huh? She's awfully quiet. Maybe she's
nervous.
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
And the gates are open! Who will make
the first
move?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
YAAAAAHHHHH! COMPETITIVE
SPIRIIIIIT!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
What's with that fighting spirit?! Wasn't
she
totally silent a second ago?! She's so
cool! Wow!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Guess I'll have to give it a shot,
if ya
insist!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm in the gate. Gotta suppress
the
fidgets... Stay cooool!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAHHHHH!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
I did it! I didn't trip up! Hey, hey! How
was I?!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Mehehe! I like this trainin'! Imma do it
like a
hundred times!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! So you're gonna get to witness
me being
cool a hundred more times!
Aren't you lucky!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: GAHHHHH?!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: Ack... Awww...
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
I'm... fine, but... I think... Imma call it... a
day...
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: She runs off in tears from the sheer pain.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Unable to say no to her beaming smile,
I stay
with her until she wears herself
out.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
